title: Bee keybindings
description: User keybindings (~/.config/bee/keybindings.json). Later entries win; a command prefixed with '-' removes earlier bindings of that command.

key.description: Key or chord, e.g. "ctrl+shift+p" or "ctrl+k ctrl+s".

command.description: Command id; prefix with '-' to remove bindings of that command.

when.description: Condition under which the binding is active, e.g. "editorFocus && !inQuickOpen".

args.description: Arguments for the command (reserved; not used yet).
